mutations.name: a snapshot renamed in from outside the snapshot paths reads as changed
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow reads a snapshot renamed into the snapshot paths as added, and one renamed out of them as removed

mutations.name: the snapshot list is not capped before it is posted
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow keeps the evidence comment under 60,000 characters when a PR regenerates hundreds of snapshots, counting what it leaves out

mutations.name: a measured pair records without its share
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow measures a changed snapshot's share from the merge base to the head
the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow leaves the decision as it is without the threshold, and keeps a record the evidence schema reads

mutations.name: the schema leaves the snapshot list unbounded
kills: VisualDeltaSchema refuses a delta with more than 40 snapshots or a string over 300 characters, so an unbounded writer fails at the parse

mutations.name: visualThreshold mode off still records the visual delta
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow records nothing when the repo's mode is off or the repo has no threshold
